notes: Same words as the 2023 twin (§2023:12.3.3 SR2), but 2002's configuration section has a form 2023 lacks: SOURCE-COMPUTER ... WITH DEBUGGING MODE, with or without computer-name-1 (§2002:12.2.4.1). A method whose configuration section writes the name-less clause is now refused by this rule (COBOL2644, a method definition shall not contain a CONFIGURATION SECTION) after the obsolete warning COBOL0903, where it was the grammar's parse error COBOL1971 (kb/Work PB5609); the named form already reached COBOL2644.
